implementation_constraints: reads one JSON value from stdin, prints one line, exits 0

unresolved_intent.decision: only a JSON array at the top level is valid; any other JSON type (object, number, string, bool, null) or invalid JSON text maps to ERROR via a single try/except around json.loads plus an isinstance(list) check
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec says 'input that is not a JSON array' -> ERROR, so the type check must reject non-list JSON values, not just malformed JSON

unresolved_intent.decision: a non-string element in the array (e.g. a number or nested object) is treated the same as an unknown event string, both routed to the same ERROR branch via an isinstance(event, str) guard before the transition lookup
unresolved_intent.rationale: spec explicitly calls out 'a non-string element' as an error case alongside unknown event strings; unifying the check keeps the machine total and closed per INV-SM-TOTAL-01

unresolved_intent.decision: model transitions as an explicit dict keyed by (state, event) tuples covering all 4 combinations, rather than nested if/elif chains
unresolved_intent.rationale: makes totality visually verifiable (4 states x events = 4 entries) and makes an unrecognized (state, event) pair naturally fall into the ERROR branch via dict lookup miss

unresolved_intent.decision: ERROR is printed via print() and the function returns normally, so the process still exits 0 as required by the contract ('print exactly ERROR', with no separate exit-code requirement for errors)
unresolved_intent.rationale: the contract only specifies stdout content for the error case, not a distinct exit code, and the general contract line says 'exit 0' unconditionally

unresolved_intent.decision: empty or whitespace-only stdin is passed straight into json.loads, which raises ValueError/JSONDecodeError, caught by the same except clause and reported as ERROR
unresolved_intent.rationale: treated as 'invalid JSON' per AC-SM-06 rather than as a special-cased empty-array shortcut, since the spec only calls an empty JSON array (not empty input) the locked-start case
